items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Fasching 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Bence Barát. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Fasching 2023 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Bence Barát. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before February 4, 2023 at 7:00 PM EST. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

items.information: お待たせしました。関西では実に約3年ぶりとなるWCA大会を、京都で開催します。 **昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。 この状況を緩和するため、異なる地域で複数のWCA大会を同時開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。 Go x Go Kyoto 2023、 Tokyo Challenge A/B/C Winter 2023のうち、ご都合の良いもの１つに申し込んでください。** 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や同伴、見学はできません。同伴を希望の場合、参加申し込み時に同伴者数をご記入ください。 見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛に2/5までにフォームにてお申込みください。 詳細は["見学や競技者への同伴"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoxGoKyoto2023#23896-request-for-observation-as-a-visitor)のタブをご確認ください。 Thank you for your patience. The WCA competition will be held in Kyoto, the first in the Kansai region in about three years. **In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them. To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions in different regions at the same time. Please register for one of Go x Go Kyoto 2023 or Tokyo Challenge A/B/C Winter 2023, whichever is most convenient for you.** The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, please be sure to apply to the organization team before 5th February. Please check ["Spectators and Guests" ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoxGoKyoto2023#23896-request-for-observation-as-a-visitor)tab for details.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. ## Competitors are limited to ONE guest. Spectators who are not associated with a registered competitor will NOT be permitted to enter the venue. ## You will only be able to register for one of Berkeley Winter A 2023 or Berkeley Winter B 2023. items.information: [FR] Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). En raison de la situation sanitaire, les conditions d'accès à la compétition peuvent changer au gré des annonces gouvernementales. L'équipe d'organisation vous informera des restrictions en vigueur à chaque changement. Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet [Santé & Sécurité](#22925-sante-securite-health-safety). **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, inscrivez votre courriel finissant par estmtl.net dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis **ne payez pas les frais d'inscription**. **Vous ne pouvez pas vous inscrire à la fois au 5x5 à l'aveugle et au megaminx**. Vous devez choisir au maximum un des deux. Si vous mettez les deux, votre inscription ne sera pas acceptée. Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée. [EN] Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Due to the sanitary situation, the conditions for accessing the competition venue can vary due to the government's announcements. The organization team will inform everybody of the restrictions as they change. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](#22925-sante-securite-health-safety). **ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **without paying the registration fee**. **You may not register for both 5x5 blindfolded and megaminx**. You must choose at most one of the two. If you put both, your registration will not be accepted. There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name; Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! items.information: Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. items.information: 11/3に行われる[Ayase Autumn A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnA2022) (以下、A大会) と11/6に行われるAyase Autumn B 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、B大会**) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 3x3x3 目隠し / スクエア1 / スキューブ / クロック / 3x3x3複数 目隠し **B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 5x5x5 キューブ / 6x6x6 キューブ / メガミンクス (2ラウンド)** 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 ###会場についての注意### 今回の会場は集会室1,2共に**靴を脱いで**利用する部屋となります。そのため、衛生上の観点から競技者及び見学者の方は**靴下の着用**をお願いします。 [Ayase Autumn A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnA2022) (A) and Ayase Autumn B 2022 (**This competition, B**) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. A: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 3x3x3 blindfolded / Square-1 / Skewb / Clock / 3x3x3 Multi-Blind **B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 5x5x5 Cube / 6x6x6 Cube / Megaminx (2 round)** The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Only the companions of competitors are allowed to enter the venue as spectators.** Being mindful of space, we can only accept requests of **1 companion at MAX per competitor.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors) ### Attention ### In room 1 and 2, you have to take off your shoes. So, you must wear socks due to hygienic reasons.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. *Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!* ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion. *Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Open 2022 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic und delegiert von Niko Ronkainen. Diesmal findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Falls Ihr Gäste dabei habt, würden wir euch bei der Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld um die Namen eure Gäste bitten. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Open 2022 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic and delegated by Niko Ronkainen. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. If you bring any guests, please write their names in the comments of your registration.

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png) Why SILENCE? We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :) We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure. We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it. We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. Happy cubing!

items.information: # 🇺🇾 NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 50 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19. Competitor limit: 50. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, July 31st is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, August 10th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. items.information: 8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte. En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. ¡Os estaremos esperando! 8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year. So don't be afraid to join us. We'll be waiting for you!

items.information: REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante; 5. Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição; 6. Em virtude do COVID-19, o local só irá comportar um número máximo de 25 competidores e 25 convidados; 7. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (blima@worldcubeassociation.org). REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name; 5. Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition; 6. Due to COVID-19, the venue will only hold a maximum of 25 competitors and 25 guests 7. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), or the delegate via email (blima@worldcubeassociation.org).

items.information: NZ South Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2022 is the first regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2022.

items.name: Oslo Open 2022
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss! Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid. Det koster 150 NOK å delta. Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet. Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo. ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015! You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The registration opens Saturday 28 of May at 6:00 PM Norwegian time. We follow local Covid restrictions. As of today, there are no special requirements or restrictions in Oslo.

items.information: Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus. Nous ne saurons avec précision le nombre de places libres que juste avant le tutoriel pour les nouveaux compétiteurs : dimanche à 9h00 nous regarderons donc si des personnes ne se sont pas présentées, et nous proposerons ces places aux personnes de la liste d'attente présentes, dans l'ordre de leur inscription. Si vous êtes sur liste d'attente vous pouvez venir dimanche matin au cas où une place se libère, mais nous ne pouvons pas garantir que vous pourrez participer, et l'accès à la salle se fera en fonction de l'affluence. Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**; bien que très longues. Elles contiennent beaucoup d'informations très utiles. ---- Since we want to make as many competitors happy as we can, we would like to offer - to the competitors on the waiting list - the spots of the registered competitors who didn't show up. We can only be sure about the number of no-shows at the beginning of the tutorial for new competitors : therefore on Sunday at 9:00, if spots are available, we will offer them to the people on the waiting list, in their registration order. If you are on the waiting list you can come on sunday morning in case a spot is free, but we can't guarantee that you will be able to participate. Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**, although they are very long. They contain a lot of very useful information.

items.information: Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus. items.name: BC Cubing Springback B 2022
items.information: Luke, Lindy, and Kevin are happy to invite you again or perhaps for your very first time to the heart of Coquitlam for 2022’s first of the year in BC event for cubing, competing and connecting together! It is spring and we are bringing cubing back to BC! Welcome upcoming competitors and guests to the BC Cubing Springback B 2022 (or A!) Both A and B competitions are part of a Series Competition. Both fall over the Victoria Day May Long Weekend, with Competition A scheduled for the Sunday and Competition B for the Monday Statutory Holiday here in this province. Registration is permitted only for ONE of these series competitions; no competitor may register for both but must choose A (Sunday May 22) OR choose B (Monday May 23 stat holiday Victoria Day). This competition is in part a show of support for the Ukrainian people at this time. Each registered competitor paying a competition fee allows cubers all together to make a charitable contribution to the World Food Programme Ukraine Emergency Appeal. Help is urgently needed for providing emergency food and water to Ukraine and the neighbouring countries affected by the war and its devastating humanitarian crisis. We pledge to donate 20% of all competition fees collected to go toward this important, very needy appeal. See [the World Food Programme website](https://www.wfp.org/support-us/stories/ukraine-appeal?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=16413288686&utm_content=136717956471&gclid=CjwKCAiAsYyRBhACEiwAkJFKos8xSLAQ3GFVytXqMxvY4c1VkBVL6kpViN8WN2_WgBe3xP6p0vxTFBoCol8QAvD_BwE&gclsrc=aw.ds). The recent and greatly anticipated changes to BC Public Health Order which applies also to social gatherings and events means that we will not be seeking the proof of vaccination status of competitors and guests in May. Happily, masking will be an option at the venue as well. As an expected and still valuable courtesy, we simply ask that those experiencing any COVID-19 like symptoms or those with a recent positive COVID-19 test refrain from attending. Competitors may arrange with the organisational team for a full refund if they need to opt out due to the onset of illness or a positive test. Naturally we have a Staying Health Informed tab here on the website to share any useful considerations pertaining to personal wellness at the competition and as a place to communicate any additional changes to the new health order - if the government re-introduces restrictions such as proof of vaccination or masks, we will update the website and email registered competitiors. Registration with a $25 CDN payment through Stripe opens Friday April 1st 6:00pm PST. Note that registration will close one week later. No on the spot registrations will be accepted. Registration is first come, first served based on the order of when payment through Stripe is received. A waitlist will be maintained for those unable to secure a spot in the competition. See the Waitlisted Competitors Tab. BY REGISTERING, YOU AGREE THAT YOU UNDERSTAND AND WILL FOLLOW ALL OF THE HEALTH AND SAFETY MEASURES LISTED IN THE HEALTH AND SAFETY TAB AND ACCEPT IF ANY OF THE MEASURES NEED TO BE NUANCED CLOSER TO THE DATE OF COMPETITION. We look forward to a full house of 60 competitors! Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we require that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

items.information: [FR] En accord avec la politique de santé publique et les directives de l'ÉTS, tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront porter un masque à l'intérieur des bâtiments. Le port du couvre-visage en tissu est interdit. Dans l'éventualité où les directives changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel. Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet Santé & Sécurité. **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, vous devez réserver votre place sur le [portail de réservation](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) dans monÉTS dans la section "Activités de la vie étudiante". Vous devez enregistrer au plus tard le vendredi 15 avril à 15h. Une fois que c'est fait j'aurais la liste des étudiants qui n'auront pas besoin de payer. Vous devez donc ensuite vous inscrire sur le site web WCA en même temps que tout le monde, simplement vous n'aurez pas à payer les frais d'inscription. Je précise que vous devez enregister le plus tôt possible, car être enregistré sur le portail de réservation ne vous garantie pas une place dans la compétition. Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée. [EN] As per the current public health policy and the directives of the university, all competitors and their guest must wear a mask at all time inside the buildings. Wearing a cloth mask is prohibited. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the regulations change. Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab. **ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, you must reserve your place on the [reservation portal](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) on monÉTS in the "Activités de la vie étudiante" section. You must register there by Friday, April 15 at 15h. Once you register there I will have the list of students who do not need to pay. You can then register on the WCA site without paying the fee. You should register as quickly as possible, as being registered on the monÉTS portal does not guarantee you a place in the competition. There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

Recomendamos llegar 15 minutos antes de cada ronda en la que vas a competir. *ENGLISH* "Madryn al Cubo 2022" will feature **7 categories** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) and **11 rounds** in total. items.information: # REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 25,00 (inscrição+camiseta) pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org). O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Essas regras podem ser mais restritas ou flexibilizadas conforme orientações dos órgãos governamentais até a data do evento. ------------ **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. Bank Account: Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. These rules may be changed to be more restrictive or flexible based upon governmental mandates until the event date.

items.information: Twisty Taranaki 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

venue.details: Senate Chamber is located on the second floor of the Ohio Union, Rhodes Center is located at the Ohio Expo Center

items.information: Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab. **Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves **Day 2:** 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks **Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis. Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. We thank you for your understanding.**

items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores, sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). Máximo un acompañante por persona. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). Only one guest per competitor allowed. * This competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

The Nazarene Theological Seminary of Peru is an evangelical institution dedicated to the preparation of Christian ministers, and are giving us kindly their facilities for the realization of the tournament, therefore, it is asked to have an appropriate behavior to the Religious Institute. We are allowed to use the place of ceremonies where the tournament will take place, go through the open spaces, and use the bathrooms. But it's forbidden to enter classrooms, offices and any other of the facilities.

( في حال رغبتكم بالمشاركة في ايفنتات اليوم الثاني فقط يرجى العلم بأنه سيتم فتح التسجيل في كلا اليومين فلا داعي للحضور لمجرد التسجيل في اليوم الأول) حرصا على سلامتكم و اتباعا لاجراءات السلامة، يرجى إبراز شهادة المطعوم عند الدخول، أو إظهار سند أخضر، أو فحص pcr لمن هم فوق ١٢ سنة و شكرا. اذا كان لديك اي استفسار او سؤال عن تفاصيل المسابقة، يرجى التواصل من خلال الايميل في الأعلى، أو من خلال صفحة Jordan cubing community عبر تطبيق Instagram. Competition details: - The competition will be held in a hall on the ground floor of Al-Hikma Secondary School for Boys, Al-Istiklal Street, near Al-Istiklal Mall. As indicated in the title above. You can enter the hall from the back entrance, where the school buses gather. Please note that the competition will be for two days and the events are divided into two days as shown in the schedule . (If you want to participate in the events of the second day only, please note that registration will be opened on both days, so there is no need to attend just to register on the first day) For the sake of your safety and to follow safety procedures, please show the vaccination certificate upon entry, or show a green bond ( from Sanad app) , or a PCR test for people over 12 years old, thank you. If you have any questions about competition details, you can ask from the email shown up, or from ( Jordan cubing community) on Instagram app. https://www.instagram.com/jocubingcommunity/

items.name: Güemes Open 2022
items.information: Güemes Open 2022 es la primera competencia que se va a realizar en la provincia de Salta, Argentina, y a su vez, la primera competencia del 2022 del país! El objetivo de esta competencia es reactivar la comunidad norteña del país. Nos esforzaremos en hacer cumplir todos los protocolos pertinentes a la pandemia. Competidores, recuerden ser puntuales, siguiendo los horarios del cronograma. Recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes para evitar inconvenientes, en especial a los nuevos competidores. Este torneo contará con 11 categorias oficiales y tendrá una duración de 2 días. *LEER LOS SIGUIENTES APARTADOS* https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta A pesar de no tener restricciones estrictas con la cantidad de personas que puede asistir y que el lugar es abierto y ventilado, recomendamos no llevar mas de 2 acompañantes para reducir al máximo los riesgos Güemes Open 2022 is the first competition to be held in the province of Salta, Argentina, and also, the first competition of 2022 in the country! The objective of this competition is to reactivate the northern community of the country. We will endeavor to enforce all protocols relevant to the pandemic. Competitors, remember to be punctual, following schedule. We recommend arriving 20 minutes before to avoid inconvenience, especially to new competitors. This tournament will have 11 official categories and will last 2 days. *READ THE FOLLOWING TABS* https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta Despite not having strict restrictions with the number of people who can attend and that the place is open and ventilated, we recommend not to bring more than 2 companions to minimize the risks

items.information: GuateMaya Open 2021 será el evento que marcará el retorno de las competencias oficiales al país. Con protocolos de Bioseguridad de las Autoridades Locales y los establecidos por la WCA, GuateMaya busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en Guatemala de la forma mas segura posible para todos nuestros competidores y asistentes. - Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. - El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. - Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años With GuateMaya 2021 we hope to return to hold official competitions regularly in the country. Using Covid-19 protocols from the local authorities and those sugested by the WCA, GuateMaya 2021 looks forward to improving the local development of the speedcubing in Guatemala, guaranteeing the safety of the competitors and staff. -Temperature will be measured at the entrance -Use of masks will be mandatory during all the competition -Vaccination proof will be required to enter to the venue

items.information: Velkomin! Ef þetta er fyrsta skipti sem þið eruð að keppa gerir WCA kröfu um **löggild skilríki** í skráningarferlinu. Það er að segja vegabréf, ökuskírteini eða nafnskírteini. *ATH: ekki nægir að koma með debitkort!* If this is your first time competing you must bring **official identification** as it is required for registration with the WCA. This means passport, driver's licence or other official ID. *Note: Payment cards are not official ID!* Vinsamlegast lesið upplýsingarnar undir [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) flipanum! Hlutir sem ber að hafa í huga áður en mætt er til keppninnar: Haltu þig heima og skráðu þig strax í PCR-sýnatöku hjá Heilsuveru ef þú finnur til einkenna/veikinda. Það er grímuskylda inni í salnum. Einungis 1 gestur fyrir hvern keppanda. Komdu með þinn eigin penna. **LESTU [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) FLIPANN FYRIR FREKARI UPPLÝSINGAR!** Takk fyrir! Please read the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) information tab! Things to consider before going to the competition: Stay at home and sign up for PCR-testing at Heilsuvera if you are feeling ill or are experiencing symptoms. Only 1 guest per competitor. Mask use is mandatory. Bring your own pen. **READ THE [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IcelandicNationals2021#16925-covid-19) TAB FOR MORE INFORMATION!** Thank you!

De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors. * Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16710-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16705-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques]https://docs.google.com/document/d/121IA2o1dPWAdlqZNCO0KyVLceeFsbFENTiVlMPThAkU/edit?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA. Note : **1 accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir. Note : Dans la cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA cancelle la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs. **[EN]** **As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16710-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the Canadian government policies detailed on the website.** Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16705-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/121IA2o1dPWAdlqZNCO0KyVLceeFsbFENTiVlMPThAkU/edit?usp=sharing). Note: **Only one (1) spectator per competitor** can attend. **If you're not a competitor or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in and cancel the competition. items.name: Norrkubing 2021
items.information: This is the 2021 edition of Norrkubing. A competition which history started in 2015, and this is the 6th time a competition has been organized in this municipality. The competition is open to everyone but limited to 25 competitors due to regulations regarding covid-19. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the COVID-19 tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub website. Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses. ----- Detta är 2021 års upplaga av Norrkubing. Tävlingen arrangerades för första gången år 2015, och detta är den sjätte gången en tävling arrangeras i denna kommun. Tävlingen är öppen för alla men begränsad till maximalt 25 deltagare på grund av restriktioner kring covid-19. Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken COVID-19, med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs hemsida. Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

items.information: **As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), all competitors and their (single) guest must provide proof of having received at least one dose of vaccination in order to enter the venue. As such, please do not register unless you will have had at least one dose of a vaccine before the competition date, as otherwise you will not be allowed to enter the venue nor compete. We will send registered competitors further details in an email when the government releases more details.** Cubing solo over the pandemic has made us only too glad to host an actual, face to face, long awaited gathering for local and perhaps not so local cubers...so welcome to BC Cubing Comeback 2021-either A or B! We the organizers of [Fraser Valley Open 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpring2018) and [2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpringOpen2019) are thrilled to invite you this time to the heart of Coquitlam for a fun and safe return to cubing, competing and most of all connecting together! Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Note that this is a **one of a pair of twin competitions**. We have not had twin competitions in BC before. Please see the [Twin Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackB2021#16216-twin-competitions) for more information. A small portion of each registration fee will be in support of the BC Fires Appeal with the Canadian Red Cross. Each dollar we donate will be matched by both the provincial and federal governments. Donations will be used for immediate and ongoing relief efforts as well as for long-term recovery and preparedness. Feel free to check out [the Red Cross page](https://www.redcross.ca/how-we-help/current-emergency-responses/2021-british-columbia-fires) for more information. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackB2021#16211-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11vtCfK4waavNE_PUpHGQ12mZxPuTA6_Hrbd79cNUhd0/edit?usp=sharing). Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free. Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers stay well within WCA recommendations. **If you're not a competitor, or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in with the additional ask that all attendees show 1) a negative test prior to venue entry or 2) that they have been fully vaccinated for 2 weeks prior. The WCA reserves the right in the event of a clear 4th wave in BC to cancel the competition outright. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers stay well within WCA recommendations. **If you're not a competitor, or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in with the additional ask that all attendees show 1) a negative test prior to venue entry or 2) that they have been fully vaccinated for 2 weeks prior. The WCA reserves the right in the event of a clear 4th wave in BC to cancel the competition outright. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.information: Välkommen till de första tävlingarna att arrangeras i tvillingformat i Sverige! Denna tävling hör ihop med [Flen - Lilla Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021), och det är endast tillåtet att anmäla sig och tävla i en av dessa två tävlingar. Mer information om detta finns under fliken [Tvillingtävling](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16201-tvillingtavling-twin-competition). Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16170-covid-19), med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs [hemsida](https://svekub.se/). Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter. ----- Welcome to the first ever twin competitions in Sweden! This competition is twinned with [Flen - Lilla Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021), and competitors may only register for and compete in one out of these two competitions. More on this can be found under the [Twin competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16201-tvillingtavling-twin-competition) tab. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16170-covid-19) tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub [website](https://svekub.se/). Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses.

items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2021 is the second regional championship held in New Zealand in the lead up to Nationals later in 2021.

items.information: Please note that there is a competition on Saturday and one on Sunday. You will be permitted to register and compete for ONLY one of the two competitions. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few. Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information: **English:** CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration. ___ **Deutsch:** Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Alle Gäste sind selbstverständlich gerne willkommen, jedoch würden wir euch aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten, uns ein kurzes Mail mit eurem Namen unter der E-Mail competitions@cubing.at zukommen zu lassen. Oder, falls Ihr einen Teilnehmer begleitet, kann Euer Name bei dessen Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld vermerkt werden. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0FJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46f5e03d373ccc1422360774454c53cb532739d2/latest%20medium%20def.png, height=3.5cm)

items.information: Español: La competencia Montevideo Palace 2019 será la tercera edición que se llevará acabo en este local. Leer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. Ésta competencia esta abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. Los acompañantes de los competidores no tiene que pagar ningún tipo de entrada ni inscripción. Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento, de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. Por favor tengan también en cuenta los artículos [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) y [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1). English: The Montevideo Palace 2019 competition will be the third edition that will take place in this venue. Read the [regulations of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. This competition is open to competitors of any nationality. Guests do not have to pay any type of entry or registration. Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the regulation. Please also take into account articles [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) and [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1).

Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.
